changelog: [When to Segment]: Added a new permissive rule distinct from the previously-rejected single-topic-NP rule: mark a boundary after each item in a coordinate/enumerated list of nouns or short clauses joined by -이랑/-랑/-하고/-도 or commas, even before the shared governing predicate appears, since each listed item is independently renderable. This increases the pool of low-risk fine-grained candidates for small-T budgets without touching the earlier (rejected) NP-before-predicate rule.

[Examples — Segment]: Removed a redundant -고-connective example (연봉도 괜찮고/워라밸도 좋다고) and replaced it with a new example illustrating the coordinate-list rule, keeping the example count at 10 (under the 12 cap) while demonstrating the new rule.
